name: Socially Awesome Awkward Penguin
look: A black-and-white penguin walks to the right with one flipper held out, cut out over a split background. The top half, behind its head and chest, is red with faint radiating rays, and the bottom half, behind its belly and feet, is blue.
use: A two-line story about a social moment. The top caption, on red, describes something smooth or confident, and the bottom caption, on blue, shows how it immediately turned awkward.
slots: the smooth, confident move (top, on red)
the awkward way it went wrong (bottom, on blue)
examples: Holds the door open for someone
They're still thirty feet away, so we both do the awkward half jog
Remembers the new coworker's name on day one
Finds out a month later it was the wrong name
describe: penguin on a half red half blue background
walking penguin with red top and blue bottom
penguin meme where it starts cool and ends embarrassing
advice animal penguin with two color split background
black and white penguin red above blue below
origin: Combines two advice-animal penguin memes: the red Socially Awesome Penguin on top and the blue Socially Awkward Penguin below.
